title: At the Bus Stop
text:
Anna meets Tom at the bus stop. 'Hello, Tom! How are you?' she says. 'I am fine, thank you,' Tom says. 'Where are you going?' 'I am going to school,' Anna says.

They walk to school together. Tom has a red bag. Anna has a blue bag. They talk and laugh on the way.

questions.text: Who does Anna meet at the bus stop?
How do Anna and Tom feel on the way to school?
What is the most likely relationship between Anna and Tom?

vocabulary.definition: a place where a bus stops for people to get on or off
with another person or other people
to make sounds that show you think something is funny

paragraph_translations: Анна зустрічає Тома на зупинці автобуса. 'Привіт, Томе! Як справи?' - каже вона. 'Добре, дякую,' - каже Том. 'Куди ти йдеш?' 'Я йду до школи,' - каже Анна.
Вони разом ідуть до школи. У Тома червоний рюкзак. У Анни синій рюкзак. По дорозі вони розмовляють і сміються.
